Nepalese Scribes and Patrons

Dated manuscripts per decade (CE), by era Nepāla Saṃvat Vikrama Saṃvat Śaka Lakṣmaṇasena other or unnamed
Links:
Row colour: the person's main role · dot colour: role in that manuscript · searching also shows undated persons

Sources: NGMCP catalogue entries (Nepal-German Manuscript Cataloguing Project). Persons come from two places: the catalogue fields Scribe, Donor and King, and a reading of each quoted colophon by Gemini Flash, with a second reading by Claude Opus wherever the first was uncertain or disagreed with the catalogue. Each attestation is marked with its source: cat catalogue field, flash Gemini reading, opus checked by Opus.

Dates follow the catalogue where it names the era; otherwise the era and year come from the colophon reading. Conversion: NS + 880, VS − 57, ŚS + 78, LS + 1119, approximate to a year. A “?” marks an inferred era.

Undated manuscripts get an estimated date (hollow dots and circles) from the people and places they name: a king attested in at least two dated manuscripts (the king's attested span ± 5 years), two persons named together in a dated manuscript (± 25), a person's dated span (± 20; graded by whether a title or residence also matches), or a specific locality whose dated manuscripts fall within 150 years. The evidence is listed with each estimate.

Persons are grouped by normalized name (without śrī and without titles such as śarman, vajrācārya, upādhyāya). A name whose dated manuscripts are more than 60 years apart is split into separate persons, so homonyms are separated only by date.
